entries.title: Crewmates on GPT-6.2 use less of your plan allowance
entries.body: A crewmate on GPT-6.2 no longer pays again for its whole instructions on every request. A crewmate on a model that charges more once a conversation gets long, such as GPT-6.2 Sol or GPT-6.1 Sol, now summarizes its conversation before it gets that long, instead of well after.
entries.noPicture: This changes what each request to the model costs, not how any view looks.
